title: pmic: FCH micelles whose amphiphile is made by the catalyst particles they hold grow and divide from noise (45 persistent splits, gen 4)
summary: c03's FCH micelle-fission world with the uniform amphiphile feed replaced by local synthesis kf K S from a fed precursor S, catalysed by ~15-25k Brownian particles that replicate on S and are kept in the micelle cores by a g(u)^2 acceptance gate, plus slow amphiphile decay kdec (u - u_bg). From white noise in u and a uniform particle soup, ~30 micelles form by t=15, deplete precursor halos and, at kf=0.03, grow and divide (labkit seed 0: 45 persistent splits, max generation 4, merge/split 0.08) until ~95 micelles pack the domain by t~400 and the precursor runs low. At kf=0.01 synthesis only balances decay and the micelles sit still (sheet_kf0.01.png); at kf=0.05 they fuse into a sea. A micelle's growth here depends on its own particles, which is what pcell lacked: cell generations (~100 t) span a few particle lifetimes (50 t) instead of ~100.
